text_block_list.text:
My outing with Jungle Pocket that day 
ended early, and we parted ways, but—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey again. Look at that, you've got 
time to kill too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't have anything to do either~ So I 
figured I'd wander around a bit until 
curfew."
choice_data_list: Wander around... you mean around here?

text_block_list.text:
The familiar town where I've spent so much 
time. Nothing in particular comes to mind 
as a fun place to stroll around, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Step outside. You're coming with me for a 
minute.

We arrived at the familiar riverbank. 
...Or so it should have been. Between the 
trees stood an unfamiliar manju shop.
choice_data_list: A manju shop in a place like this...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"And this right here is the local 
specialty, 'Kata-manju'! It's a sweet I 
heavily vouch for."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You eat some too. Can't go fooling around 
on an empty stomach, right?

"Kata" (hard) manju, when they're supposed 
to be soft? What on earth could they taste 
like? ...With various thoughts in mind, 
taking a bite reveals—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~, this red bean paste is so sweet! 
The texture is amazing!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, it's delicious! And it seems really 
filling too...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! It's great right before 
independent training. You can wolf it down 
in no time.

It wasâthe back alley of a familiar 
shopping district. The entire wall was 
painted in vibrant spray art.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The building owner provided the wall so 
people can draw freely, y'know. Saying, 
"This isn't graffiti, it's art."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I don't really get all the 
complicated stuff either. It's just a 
great painting, y'know?"

At the end of her gaze was... a painting 
drawn freely, with no pattern or 
regularity to its colors and composition.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I love that about it too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"It's like, you can totally feel the 
scream of their soul, you know?"
This is our usual park. Yet now, it—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—She nailed it! That execution score is 
insane! —Isn't that height way too crazy!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The heck was that trick just now?! The 
skateboard was floating in midair, wasn't 
it...?!

It had become an officially opened free 
battle arena— a place to compete with 
skateboard tricks!
choice_data_list:
It looks like so much fun being able to 
control it so freely...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, your knees are shaking! You'll 
never handle a skateboard like that, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Can't be helped, then!... I'll pull you 
along by the hand, so come on, let's go!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, that was so much fun~.
choice_data_list: I'm gonna be sore all over tomorrow……

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! When that time comes, I'll stretch 
together with you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...And? How was it? Taking a stroll 
around, I mean.

Every place we visited was inside the 
familiar city. And yet—
choice_data_list:
I was totally full of excitement for the 
unknown!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, I'll show you one last thing. A 
real special treat."

Suddenly, something covers my eyes. And 
just like that—I'm led somewhere.
choice_data_list: Huh, what?! What is it this time—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, take it easy. If anything 
happens, I'll back ya up from behind.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we're here! ...Come on, open your 
eyes.

Following the voice speaking softly into 
my ear, I timidly opened my eyes—

Spread out before my eyes was the 
nightscape. The city I had run around 
playing in with Jungle Pocket. It was... 
shining like a sea of light.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: This is my "city."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Pretty awesome, right?
choice_data_list:
I think it's precisely because you're 
here.
I think it's precisely because you're here

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Pretty awesome, right?
choice_data_list:
I think it's precisely because you're 
here.
I think it's precisely because you're here

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Heheh. Let's hang out again, alright?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Next time, it'll be your "city."

"Otherwise, I never would have noticed. 
This city's charm... or how much more 
beautiful the night view looks."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
